clippings.speaker: Ethan Hawke
clippings.quote: Julie and I auditioned for this little romantic movie “Before Sunrise.” The idea that we would’ve had this lifelong collaboration and that we would’ve poured so much of ourselves into it.
clippings.title: A chat with Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy and director Richard Linklater (“Before Midnight”)
clippings.context: Roundtable for Before Midnight, answering what had surprised him about their working relationship.

clippings.speaker: Ethan Hawke
clippings.quote: I’d say I learned how to speak on camera in “Before Sunrise.” As a young actor, you get asked to pose or affect an emotion, but Richard wanted Julie and I to talk and to be present in front of the camera and not act.
clippings.title: A chat with Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy and director Richard Linklater (“Before Midnight”)
clippings.context: Roundtable for Before Midnight, answering how the trilogy had changed them as artists.

clippings.speaker: Ethan Hawke
clippings.quote: Neither one of us have a wrinkle in the world. But we watch it and I remember how insecure we felt being that age.
clippings.title: Then and Now: How Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy Have Changed from 'Before Sunrise' to 'Before Midnight'
clippings.context: Said in a Nightline interview with Delpy, watching the first film together as they reached their 40s; the piece is by Juju Chang.

notes: Hawke side is well sourced; Delpy has only one usable line about Hawke. Backstage, RogerEbert, Inquirer, Slant and Today were blocked or had nothing usable; the NPR and Time Out pages were read but gave only trio or banter lines. Date for the No Film School quote is the reprint's; the Guardian original date was not verified.
